Reference / config/document

config/document#

Settings read from a parsed JSON, TOML or INI document.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let file = SettingSource(kind: SettingSourceKind.document, name: "app.toml");
let settings = TomlSettings(document: ParsedToml(text).root(), source: file);
settings.membership(SettingKey("server", "port"));

Description#

Settings read from a parsed JSON, TOML or INI document.

Nested tables and sections become dotted keys; arrays become several values. Combine them with environment and command-line settings in LayeredSettings.

Public API#

object JsonSettings#

object JsonSettings does SettingReading

A JSON object as settings: nested members extend the key path, an array of scalars is one multi-value entry, other scalars are single entries.
